title: Graded section ring of an invertible module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Its nonnegatively graded section ring is $\Gamma_*(X,\mathcal L)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf N}\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$. Addition is componentwise. Multiplication of homogeneous sections of degrees $i,j$ is their tensor product, transported along $\mathcal L^{\otimes i}\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes j}\cong\mathcal L^{\otimes(i+j)}$; the unit is the section $1$ of $\mathcal L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_X$. The degree-$n$ subgroup is the image of the inclusion of the $n$th summand. These operations make it a graded commutative ring.
